bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: 'big bets' (AI-driven assisted tax, money platform, mid-market) are now ~30% of revenue and each growing over 30%, and management says it saw no meaningful tax share loss to AI-native entrants this season (research/INTU/2026-10-07.md section 1 and 2; Investor Day 2026 and Goldman transcripts). It is a minority-probability scenario because management itself guided FY2027 to a slower 'reset year' with Q1 and FY27 EPS guidance below consensus (factsheet News & sentiment, TheFly 2026-09-17 headlines), making a near-term re-rating catalyst the less likely of the three paths.

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bull target (P/E re-rates 17.3x->22.0x peer median = $368.54) priced instead on EV/EBITDA (11.5x->14.6x peer median = $367.93) and P/FCF (8.9x->16.8x peer median = $547.06, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table peer-median column): spread $179.12 / 2 / $368 target = 24.34%. The P/FCF anchor diverges sharply because INTU's FCF/NI conversion (190%, Quality table) is far above peers', so re-rating to peers' P/FCF level implies a much higher price than re-rating to their P/E or EV/EBITDA level -- genuine cross-anchor disagreement, capped below the 44.33% blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: Base case is the modal outcome: every multiple already sits below its own 5-year minimum (P/E 17.3x vs 18.9x min, EV/EBITDA 11.5x vs 12.6x min, P/FCF 8.9x vs 10.0x min, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table) while ROIC, ROE and margins keep rising (Quality table) -- consistent with the guided FY2027 reset playing out without either a confirmed re-rating catalyst or a confirmed fundamental deterioration (research/INTU/2026-10-07.md sections 2-3).

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the base target (P/FCF reverts to its 5y minimum 10.0x from 8.9x = $325.63) priced instead on EV/EBITDA (11.5x->12.6x 5y min = $317.53) and P/E (17.3x->18.9x 5y min = $316.61, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table 5y-min column), margins held flat: spread $9.02 / 2 / $326 target = 1.38%, well under the 44.33% blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

bear.probability_evidence: Management's own comment that price (not AI-native competition) is the top reason DIY tax customers left, plus Q1 FY27 EPS guidance of $2.44-2.48 (vs $2.72 consensus) and FY27 EPS guidance of $22.88-23.12 (vs $24.18 consensus) (factsheet News & sentiment, TheFly 2026-09-17 headlines; research/INTU/2026-10-07.md section 6), support a plausible but minority-probability path where the FY2026 FCF-margin step-up (40.4%) proves partly transitory and reverts toward the FY2025 level (32.5%).

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bear target (P/FCF held at 8.9x, FCF margin reverts 40.4%->32.5% FY2025 level = $233.14) priced instead via the analogous FY2025 margin reversion on EV/EBITDA (operating margin 28.8%->26.2% FY2025, multiple held at 11.5x = $263.65) and P/E (net margin 21.3%->20.5% FY2025, multiple held at 17.3x = $278.93, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality table FY2025 column): spread $45.79 / 2 / $233 target = 9.83%, under the 44.33% blended residual vol (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).
